_about: The parity gate's configuration (tests/parity/compare.mjs). `gates` names what slice P2-09 owns: `full` routes are compared whole (landmarks, headings, controls, list fields, row heights at 375); `frame` routes only for the shell the slice draws (frameControls, frameHeadings); `pixelExact` routes also gate on the 2 percent pixel diff. `approved` lists the differences from the baseline that a ruling allows, each with its ruling; nothing else may differ. Later UI slices add their routes to `gates` in their own PR.

approved.ruling: ASSEMBLY H.1 (shell-list.md AppShell row): the old page nested a second <main> inside the shell's <main>; the shell supplies the one main landmark.
ux-laws.md law 2 (binding, DP-2): fields and buttons are at least 44 px; artboard 16 draws 36 px fields. DESIGN CHANGES OWED #1 (artboard 16). Structure still gates.
Same as auth-field-height: / signed out lands on /login.

workspace.md (P1-02) section 7, rows SavedSearchesSection and DataSummary: TRASH as code (browser-only storage with roadmap copy and recall parameters the list never reads; a count of the client-held list, not the corpus). The remaining sections renumber under the section index (S3 Data, S4 Archive, S5 Help). A workspace-scoped saved view needs its own ruling and a table (IMPROVEMENTS).

approved.match: ^textbox:(Your name|https://…|A short bio for the community)?$
approved.ruling: ux-laws.md law 14 and DP-2: the visible field labels (Full name, Headshot URL, Work email, Bio) become the controls' accessible names; the old names were placeholders, the last field had none. Layout, copy and order are unchanged.

INV-216 (the absence rule, binding): the words unscored, pending and not scored never render on a customer surface. The awareness note keeps its place and its job (it points at how impact is read) as the link 'How impact is read', which opens the legend. DESIGN CHANGES OWED (artboard 06).

Operator 2026-10-16: 44 px is the standard on every control, so the nav card rows are 44 px (pitch 46) where artboard 01 draws about 42 (DESIGN CHANGES OWED 10); and rule 2 / INV-263: the nav cap draws no band split while the counts are unknown, where artboard 01 shows an equal 25 percent split that is a fabricated number (OWED 11). Structure still gates.

regulations.md (P1-19) section 8, rows MapPage, rollup and centroids: the register is ISO-keyed (a country, its subdivisions rolled up); the legacy-slug rows (Global, Nordic, GB beside United Kingdom, the regional remainders) and the title-regex keying that put a Japan item under us are the defect the rollup replaces.
